summary: fractal-ui restores a saved reading position to the captured member's current turn when older history renames or splits a leading turn, even if the old turn id still exists

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes; no protocol, harness or CLI change. ScrollAnchor's Reading variant gains an optional member, and WorkLogV1 gains optional summaryAnchorId and summaryMemberIds. Anchors saved without a member keep restoring by entry; hosts that omit the WorkLogV1 props render no new attributes.
